topic.source_contract: Protected-species licensing, mitigation and district-level licensing

facts.guard: planning permission does not remove licensing requirements
scheme availability is not licence grant
risk zone and IACPC are not permission to start work
DLL does not cover other protected species

facts.purpose: flexibility in survey, mitigation and compensation evidence
facts.guard: policy use does not remove need for a licence where activity would be illegal

scope_guards: Planning permission and a protected-species licence remain distinct decisions.
The three licensing tests must be evidenced for the relevant species and proposal.
District-level licensing applies only where a valid scheme operates and the proposal is eligible.
Red, amber and green risk zones are screening and scheme-route evidence, not parcel species surveys.
An IACPC is not the final district-level licence or approval to start work.
DLL for great crested newts does not cover other protected or priority species and habitats.
Survey class licences, mitigation licences and district-level licences remain distinct.
No score or promotion is written without exact species evidence, route, licence status, planning consent and site geometry.
